title: Anatole France — All works
author: Anatole France
current_text: On 31 May 1922, the Catholic Church put Anatole France — All works on its Index Librorum Prohibitorum; the Index was abolished in 1966.

sources.quote: On 31 May 1922, France's entire works were put on the Index Librorum Prohibitorum ("List of Prohibited Books") of the Catholic Church. He regarded this as a "distinction". This Index was abolished in 1966.
sources.title: Anatole France - Wikipedia
